# Schemas

<!-- Generated by `npm run export-schemas` from packages/schema/src. Do not edit by hand. -->

GoldSim's data is JSON validated against these schemas. They are defined once in TypeScript with [TypeBox](https://github.com/sinclairzx81/typebox) (`packages/schema/src/`), which gives both the JSON Schema and the TypeScript types. The JSON Schema files in [`docs/schemas/`](schemas/) are for editors, other tools, and Claude.

- Units are SI: meters, seconds, kilograms, radians. Headings are counter-clockwise from +x.
- Validate a game module folder with `npm run validate-game -- <folder>` (schemas plus cross-file checks).
- Field elements are authored from the blue side; `mirror: true` generates the red copy (`<id>.blue` / `<id>.red`).
- Robot designs are never checked against robot-construction rules (PRD §8.6). Only values the sim needs to run are checked.

| Schema | File | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| Robot design | [`robot.schema.json`](schemas/robot.schema.json) | A 2D robot: chassis, drivetrain, mounted mechanisms. |
| Game module: game.json | [`game.schema.json`](schemas/game.schema.json) | game.json: match metadata and timeline. |
| Game module: field.json | [`field.schema.json`](schemas/field.schema.json) | field.json |
| Game module: pieces.json | [`pieces.schema.json`](schemas/pieces.schema.json) | pieces.json |
| Game module: scoring.json | [`scoring.schema.json`](schemas/scoring.schema.json) | scoring.json |
| Game module: rules.json | [`rules.schema.json`](schemas/rules.schema.json) | rules.json |
| Game module: mechanisms.json | [`mechanisms.schema.json`](schemas/mechanisms.schema.json) | mechanisms.json |
| Game module: named-commands.json | [`named-commands.schema.json`](schemas/named-commands.schema.json) | named-commands.json: PathPlanner named command -> sim action. |
| Game module: stats.json | [`stats.schema.json`](schemas/stats.schema.json) | stats.json |
| Replay | [`replay.schema.json`](schemas/replay.schema.json) | Seed + versions + input log; re-simulates deterministically. |

## Robot design

A 2D robot: chassis, drivetrain, mounted mechanisms.

File: [`docs/schemas/robot.schema.json`](schemas/robot.schema.json)

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `schemaVersion` | `1` | yes |  |
| `name` | string | yes |  |
| `description` | string |  |  |
| `chassis` | object | yes |  |
| `chassis.frame` | object \| object | yes |  |
| `chassis.frame〈rect〉.type` | `"rect"` | yes |  |
| `chassis.frame〈rect〉.length` | number (> 0) | yes | frame length along the robot's +x (forward) axis, meters, bumpers excluded |
| `chassis.frame〈rect〉.width` | number (> 0) | yes | frame width along the robot's +y (left) axis, meters, bumpers excluded |
| `chassis.frame〈polygon〉.type` | `"polygon"` | yes |  |
| `chassis.frame〈polygon〉.points` | object[] | yes | Convex frame outline in the chassis frame (meters, origin at robot center). |
| `chassis.frame〈polygon〉.points[].x` | number | yes |  |
| `chassis.frame〈polygon〉.points[].y` | number | yes |  |
| `chassis.height` | number (> 0) | yes | driving height in meters (used for height-gated passages) |
| `chassis.bumpers` | object | yes |  |
| `chassis.bumpers.thickness` | number (≥ 0) | yes | bumper thickness beyond the frame, meters |
| `chassis.bumpers.mass` | number (≥ 0) | yes | bumper mass, kg |
| `chassis.mass` | number (> 0) | yes | robot mass without bumpers, kg |
| `chassis.momentOfInertia` | `"auto"` \| number | yes | 'auto' computes it from the footprint assuming uniform density. |
| `chassis.drivetrain` | object | yes | Drivetrain model. Motor and gearbox limits are expressed as speed and acceleration caps. |
| `chassis.drivetrain.type` | `"swerve"` \| `"tank"` \| `"mecanum"` | yes | swerve and mecanum are holonomic; tank cannot strafe. |
| `chassis.drivetrain.maxSpeed` | number (> 0) | yes | top translational speed, m/s |
| `chassis.drivetrain.maxAccel` | number (> 0) | yes | translational acceleration limit, m/s^2 |
| `chassis.drivetrain.maxAngularSpeed` | number (> 0) | yes | top rotational speed, rad/s |
| `chassis.drivetrain.maxAngularAccel` | number |  | rotational acceleration limit, rad/s^2 (default 4 x maxAngularSpeed) |
| `chassis.drivetrain.traction` | number (> 0) | yes | wheel friction coefficient; caps pushing force at traction x weight |
| `chassis.drivetrain.strafeFactor` | number |  | mecanum only: sideways speed as a fraction of maxSpeed (default 0.8) |
| `mechanisms` | object[] | yes |  |
| `mechanisms[].id` | string | yes | Unique within the robot, e.g. 'intake1'. |
| `mechanisms[].type` | string | yes | Core type (intake, storage, transfer, shooter, placer, climber, blocker) or a custom type id from the game module's mechanisms.json. |
| `mechanisms[].mount` | object | yes | Where the mechanism sits on the chassis, in the chassis frame. |
| `mechanisms[].mount.x` | number | yes | meters forward of robot center |
| `mechanisms[].mount.y` | number | yes | meters left of robot center |
| `mechanisms[].mount.theta` | number | yes | radians; the direction the mechanism faces relative to robot forward |
| `mechanisms[].params` | map of number \| boolean \| string | yes | Type-specific parameters. Missing values use the type's defaults. |
| `mechanisms[].stateMachine` | string |  | Preset state machine id, e.g. 'intake.default'. |
| `preload` | number (≥ 0) |  | game pieces held at match start (capped by the game's preload limit) |
